data.title: Bitcoin Faces $85,000–$87,500 Supply Test After $80,000 Rebound
data.description: TL;DR: Glassnode’s October 21 report identifies an overhead Bitcoin supply zone around $85,000–$87,500 after bids returned near $80,000.
